description: Official MM original version, universe, schema/license and Coding Procedure verification remain unresolved globally; read local codebook does not close this gate.

description: Open-web searches do not reproduce LexisNexis or a systematic newspaper archive. Forty-six queries constitute a documented first pass, not exhaustive coverage or proof of zero events.

description: Annual rights bodies describe press/assembly restrictions and forced national service. Such context may suppress observable reporting and cannot establish absence of domestic assemblies.
required_followup: Seek attributable contemporaneous independent reporting and preserve uncertainty in any zero-candidate summary.

description: English, Arabic and Tigrinya searches were performed; selected BBC Tigrinya January section was read with limited language competence. No independent fluent-language review, systematic Tigre/Afar/Saho/Bilen/Kunama/Nara review, or audio transcription was completed.

required_followup: Review regional local sources, distinguish domestic Eritrea from Tigray/Ethiopia and diaspora places, and record actual locations.

description: Radio Erena, Assenna, EritreaHub, Eri-Platform, Awate, Asmarino, HRCE and official-source searches did not amount to a complete archive issue/audio/video review.
required_followup: Review accessible January issues and broadcasts with dated, attributable evidence. Do not infer an archive is empty from returned search results.

description: One hundred seventy-nine source cards remain search_only, including historical, foreign and irrelevant search noise. All discovered URLs are preserved; no unread body supplies substantive exclusion/candidate claims.
required_followup: Prioritize relevant unread January domestic leads and original documents. UNHCR open returned a tool internal error, not a demonstrated site denial; ordinary public HTTPS recovery remains available.

description: Rights-report mirrors/translations are the same origin; EEPA republication is a secondary compilation. EEPA links the Stop Slavery statement and HRCE account, so these URL pairs are not independent corroboration.
required_followup: Track original organizations, syndication and mirrors; seek independent contemporary accounts where a real domestic assembly lead emerges.

description: 2021 editions/publications surfaced 2013, 2017 and January 2020 episodes. HRW World Report 2021 explicitly covers 2020; HRW World Report 2022 covers 2021.
required_followup: Verify article-body event dates and original episode ownership before any candidate or continuation assignment; preserve unknown exact days.

description: December 2020 and February 2021 boundary searches were performed but no verified physically continuing domestic episode was established. Historical imprisonment and continuing political campaigns alone are not physical continuations.
required_followup: Recheck accessible neighboring-month sources if a specific episode is discovered; keep start-month ownership and any true physical closure separate from publication, agreement or work resumption.

description: No read source establishes a January 2021 public gathering inside Eritrea of at least 50 people with an articulated own-government/policy demand. This is an evidence result, not an event-absence finding.
required_followup: For any future domestic lead verify simultaneous actual attendance and stated demand; do not substitute conscript totals, online volunteers, refugees, prisoners, recruits or cumulative campaign numbers.

description: War casualties, forced refugee removal, motivating detention and army conscription reports cannot be transferred into protest-specific state response or protester violence fields.
required_followup: Require episode-specific response evidence. Formal reception/negotiation may establish accommodation; actual attempted breakup may establish dispersal; presence or shootings/beatings alone do not automatically establish a separate dispersal action.

description: PBS transcript sections were read; the video was not watched. Annual reports and BBC retrospective were selectively read for relevant sections, not treated as complete event censuses.
required_followup: Inspect further source sections or visual footage only when relevant; preserve exact read/visual scope and avoid absence inference.

description: Q035–Q038 executed during an observed window 2026-10-08T10:36:24+00:00 to 2026-10-08 10:37:53 UTC. An encoding failure prevented retaining the exact pre-request timestamp. executed_at is deliberately null; recovery time/window are logged.

required_followup: Use body dates/locations and original reports rather than search dates, snippets or result ordering. Review irrelevant discoveries only as needed.
